author: WaveConquerer
body:
I was on in a match of Nexus when someone pointed out to me that Sniper and Archer are practically the same kit, but one simply has no drawbacks in comparison to the other.  Archer has a full set of Leather armor as well as a normal bow and a wood sword, 32 arrows.  Sniper has full chain, as well as a power 1 punch 1 bow, a wood sword, 32 arrows, and a speed 1 buff, and is quite obviously a better choice, rendering the Archer kit obsolete after obtaining level 16.

I would like to see the Archer kit become a bit more attractive by making one change to it's load out: add infinity to the bow.  By doing this, one would be able to bow down their enemies for as long as they are living.  The Sniper kit would then become just a way to get major kills while being restricted.

Thoughts?

replies.author: WaveConquerer
replies.body: The goal of this is to promote the use of Archer simply by having it actually carry some worth, as well to give newer players a ranged kit that doesn't take a somewhat long amount of time to get.  Players who play Archer SHOULD be able to bow down their enemies without worry of running out of ammo and thus making it worthless, just as those with sniper should use their extra perks to their advantage, but not without restriction.
